name: Clairvoyance

components.m: a focus worth 100+ GP: a jeweled horn for hearing or a glass eye for seeing

targets.description: a familiar location, or an obvious unfamiliar one, within 1 mile

summary: Place an Invisible sensor within 1 mile and see or hear through it for up to 10 minutes.
text: Create an Invisible sensor within 1 mile, either at a place you know (somewhere you have visited or seen) or at an obvious spot you don't know, such as behind a door, around a corner or in a grove. The sensor is intangible and invulnerable and stays in place for the duration. When you cast the spell, choose seeing or hearing; you use that sense through the sensor as if you were standing in its space. You can switch between seeing and hearing as a Bonus Action. A creature that can see the sensor (for example with See Invisibility or Truesight) sees a glowing orb about the size of a fist. Casting time 10 minutes.
